{
  "population": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "raceId": "=lookup(creaturePopulation, defined('population') ? #population : any)"

    "__no_id": true,

  },
  "creature_name": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "_kind": "=defined('kind') ? #kind : 'hero'",
    "name": "=lookup(forename, #_kind)"
  },
  "creature": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "terrain": "any",
    "_family": "=defined('family') ? select(creatureFamilies, #family, 'owns(creatureDimensions, #__it)') : (defined('raceId') || defined('body')) ? dig(select(creatureKinds, default, 'fits(#__it, \"terrain\", \"raceId\", \"body\") && owns(creatureDimensions, dig(#__it, \"family\"))'), 'family') : select(creatureFamilyPool, #terrain, 'owns(creatureDimensions, #__it)')",
    "*creature": "=gen(lookup(creatureFamilies, #_family))"
  },
  "animal": {
    "__no_id": true,
    ">family": "animal",
    "terrain": "any",
    "_kind": "=select(creatureKinds, animal, 'fits(#__it, \"terrain\", \"body\", \"raceId\") && (defined(\"adaptation\") ? dig(#__it, \"_adaptationTerrains\", #adaptation, #terrain) : true)')",
    "body": "=dig(#_kind, 'body')",
    "_body": "=gen('_animal_body')",
    "*creature": "=gen('_creature_complete')"
  },
  "humanoid": {
    "__no_id": true,
    ">family": "humanoid",
    "terrain": "any",
    "_kind": "=select(creatureKinds, humanoid, 'fits(#__it, \"terrain\", \"body\", \"raceId\", \"classId\") && (defined(\"adaptation\") ? dig(#__it, \"_adaptationTerrains\", #adaptation, #terrain) : true)')",
    "raceId": "=dig(#_kind, 'raceId')",
    "_class": "=select(creatureClass, defined('classId') ? #classId : default, 'dig(#_kind, \"_classIds\", dig(#__it, \"_key\"))')",
    "classId": "=dig(#_class, '_key')",
    "_body": "=gen('_humanoid_body')",
    "*creature": "=gen('_creature_complete')"
  },
  "construct": {
    "__no_id": true,
    ">family": "construct",
    "terrain": "any",
    "_kind": "=select(creatureKinds, construct, 'fits(#__it, \"terrain\", \"body\", \"raceId\", \"role\") && (defined(\"adaptation\") ? dig(#__it, \"_adaptationTerrains\", #adaptation, #terrain) : true)')",
    "_material": "=select(constructMaterial, defined('material') ? #material : default, 'fits(#__it, \"terrain\")')",
    "material": "=dig(#_material, '_key')",
    "_role": "=select(creatureRole, defined('role') ? #role : default, 'dig(#_kind, \"_roles\", dig(#__it, \"_key\"))')",
    "role": "=dig(#_role, '_key')",
    "body": "=dig(#_kind, 'body')",
    "_body": "=gen('_construct_body')",
    "*creature": "=gen('_creature_complete')"
  },
  "_animal_body": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "trace": [
      "family:animal"
    ],
    "*scores": "=gen(attributes)",
    "classId": "",
    ">level": 1,
    "*body": "=lookup(creatureBody, #body)",
    "name": "=humanize(#body)"
  },
  "_humanoid_body": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "_requestedWeapon": "=defined('weapon') ? #weapon : ''",
    "_requestedArmor": "=defined('armor') ? #armor : ''",
    ">level": 1,
    "*scores": "=gen(attributes)",
    "*ancestry": "=lookup(creatureAncestry, #raceId)",
    "*class": "=#_class",
    ">weapon": "=#_requestedWeapon != '' ? #_requestedWeapon : pick(#weapons)",
    ">armor": "=#_requestedArmor != '' ? #_requestedArmor : pick(#armors)",
    "name": "=capitalize(#raceId) + ' ' + #classId"

  "_construct_body": {

    "classId": "",

    "*role": "=#_role",
    "name": "=(#materialName != '' ? #materialName + ' ' : '') + (#roleName != '' ? #roleName : humanize(#body))"
  },
  "_creature_complete": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "_owned": "=select(creatureFamilies, dig(#_kind, 'family'), 'owns(creatureDimensions, #__it)')",
    "_requestedName": "=defined('name') ? #name : ''",
    "_requestedLevel": "=defined('level') ? #level : 0",
    "*kind": "=#_kind",
    "*defaults": "=gen(creature_defaults)",
    "*body": "=#_body",
    "_adaptation": "=select(environmentAdaptation, defined('adaptation') ? #adaptation : default, 'dig(#_kind, \"_adaptationTerrains\", dig(#__it, \"_key\"), #terrain) && dig(#__it, \"_terrains\", #terrain)')",
    "adaptation": "=dig(#_adaptation, '_key')",
    "*adaptation": "=#_adaptation",
    ">name": "=#_requestedName != '' ? #_requestedName : #name",
    ">level": "=#_requestedLevel > 0 ? #_requestedLevel : #level",
    "slotScore": "=dig(#_self, #slotAttribute)",
    "_statistics": "=gen(creature_statistics)",
    ">maxHp": "=dig(#_statistics, 'maxHp')",
    ">maxMana": "=dig(#_statistics, 'maxMana')",
    ">speed": "=dig(#_statistics, 'speed')",
    ">abilities": "=uniq(#abilities)",
    ">traits": "=uniq(#traits)",
    "!remove": [
      "hitDie",
      "fixedHp",
      "hpBonus",
      "manaBonus",
      "slotBase",
      "slotMultiplier",
      "slotAttribute",
      "weapons",
      "armors",
      "slotScore",
      "materialName",
      "roleName"
    ]
  },
  "creature_defaults": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "level": 0,
    "hitDie": 0,
    "slotBase": 0,
    "slotAttribute": "intelligence",
    "slotMultiplier": 0,
    "traits": [],
    "abilities": [],
    "trace": [],
    "fixedHp": 0,
    "hpBonus": 0,
    "manaBonus": 0
  },
  "creature_statistics": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "_slotScore": "=defined('slotScore') ? #slotScore : 10",
    ">maxHp": "=max(1, (#fixedHp > 0 ? #fixedHp : (#level <= 1 ? max(1, #hitDie + max(0, round((#constitution - 10) / 2))) : max(2, round(#hitDie + (#level - 1) * #hitDie / 2 + round((#constitution - 10) / 2))))) + #hpBonus)",
    ">maxMana": "=max(0, #slotBase + 2 + #level + #slotMultiplier * max(0, round((#_slotScore - 10) / 2)) + #manaBonus)",
    ">speed": "=max(0, round((#dexterity - 10) / 2))"
  },
  "character": {
    "__no_id": true,
    "_parameters": {
      "family": "humanoid"
    },
    "*creature": "=gen(creature, #_parameters)"
  }
}

data/kits/raider-hold/cave/hold.kyr:
Module cave_hold "A cave hold" {
  Description "A cave in a hillside behind a screen of brambles: a mouth where the watch sits, a smoky cavern, a ledge up a notched log where the chief sleeps, a pit for captives, a dry side-cave for plunder, a crack that looks out over the road, and a chimney that comes out on the hillside above.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place lair "the cave" is site within land.
  Place mouth "the cave mouth" is room within lair at 0, 1.
  Place cavern "the smoky cavern" is room within lair at 1, 1.
  Place ledge "the high ledge" is room within lair at 1, 0.
  Place pit "the captives' pit" is room within lair at 2, 1.
  Place cache "a dry side-cave" is room within lair at 2, 0.
  Place crack "the spy-crack" is room within lair at 0, 0.
  Place hillside "the hillside above the cave" is room within lair at 1, 2.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert unlit(cache). Initially Assert unlit(crack). Initially Assert indoors(cavern).

  Passage brambles "the brambles across the cave mouth" is passage between outside and mouth taking 10 minutes.
  Passage cave_throat "the throat of the cave" is passage between mouth and cavern.
  Passage notched_log "a notched log" is climb between cavern and ledge.
  Passage pit_rope "a rope ladder down into the pit" is climb between cavern and pit.
  Passage cache_crawl "a crawl into the side-cave" is crawl between cavern and cache.
  Passage crack_way "a cleft in the wall" is passage between mouth and crack.
  Passage chimney "the chimney" is climb between cavern and hillside taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known needing climbing or rope.
  Passage hill_path "a goat-track down the hillside" is path between hillside and outside taking 20 minutes.

  Observe mouth_scene at mouth when true "The cave mouth, behind its brambles: a fire-blackened ceiling, gnawed bones, and a stool for whoever keeps watch.".
  Observe cavern_scene at cavern when true "A big smoky cavern with a fire in the middle and the smoke going up into a black hole in the roof. A notched log leans against the wall up to a ledge; a rope ladder hangs into a pit.".
  Observe ledge_scene at ledge when true "A ledge high in the cavern wall, out of the smoke: a bed of skins, and a chest.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit with sheer sides and a muck floor. You would not climb out of it without the rope.".
  Observe cache_scene at cache when true "A dry side-cave stacked with plunder.".
  Observe crack_scene at crack when true "A cleft in the rock that looks straight down on the road below.".
  Observe hillside_scene at hillside when true "The open hillside above the cave. Smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks.".
  Observe chimney_hint at cavern when not knows(party, backway_known) "The smoke goes up the hole in the roof as if it had somewhere to go.".

  Thing chest "a chest on the ledge" at ledge {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "A chest stands on the ledge, locked.".
    State open "The chest on the ledge stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's lock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Break the chest open" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at cache {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "The smoke-hole in the cave's roof is a chimney that comes out on the hillside above; a climber could go up or down it." {
    Found by searching cavern "Up the smoke-hole there is daylight, and a crack worn by hands and feet: a chimney, and someone climbs it.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Up the hillside, smoke comes out of a hole among the rocks, and there is a goat-track to it.".
    Found by searching hillside "Among the rocks the smoke comes out of a crack you could climb down, with a rope or a good grip.".
  }
  Goal false.
}
data/kits/raider-hold/ringfort/hold.kyr:
Module ringfort "A ring-fort" {
  Description "An old earth ring on a rise: a ditch and a bank topped with stakes, a stake gate, a yard, a long hall roofed with turf over a store-pit, a lookout mound, and a souterrain from the pit that comes out among the gorse below.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place land "The region" is region.
  Place outside "The approach" is room.

  Place fort "the ring-fort" is site within land.
  Place under "Under the hall" is level within fort.
  Place ditch "the ditch under the bank" is room within fort at 0, 2.
  Place yard "the yard inside the ring" is room within fort at 1, 1.
  Place hall "the long hall" is room within fort at 1, 0.
  Place den "the far end of the hall" is room within fort at 2, 0.
  Place pens "the pens" is room within fort at 2, 1.
  Place mound "the lookout mound" is room within fort at 0, 1.
  Place gorse "a hole among the gorse" is room within fort at 2, 2.
  Place pit "the store-pit" is room within under at 1, 0.
  Initially Assert unlit(pit). Initially Assert indoors(hall). Initially Assert indoors(den).

  Passage bank_path "the path up the bank" is path between outside and ditch taking 20 minutes.
  Passage stake_gate "the stake gate" is gate between ditch and yard.
  Passage hall_door "the hall door" is door between yard and hall.
  Passage hide_curtain "a curtain of hides" is doorway between hall and den.
  Passage pen_hurdle "the pen hurdle" is gate between yard and pens.
  Passage mound_steps "the steps up the mound" is steps between yard and mound.
  Passage pit_ladder "the ladder down into the store-pit" is ladder between hall and pit.
  Passage souterrain "the souterrain" is crawl between pit and gorse taking 30 minutes hidden until backway_known.
  Passage gorse_path "a way out through the gorse" is path between gorse and outside taking 20 minutes hidden until backway_known.

  Observe ditch_scene at ditch when true "A deep ditch under a bank of turf, and along the top of the bank a fence of stakes as tall as a man. Things hang from the stakes and turn in the wind: bones, rags, a doll.".
  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "The yard inside the ring is trodden mud, with a long turf-roofed hall, a hurdle pen, and a mound with a lookout's seat on top.".
  Observe hall_scene at hall when true "The long hall is low and smoky, with a fire in a pit down the middle and sleeping-straw along the walls. A ladder goes down through a hole in the floor at one end.".
  Observe den_scene at den when true "The far end of the hall, behind hides: a heap of fleeces like a throne, and a chest.".
  Observe pens_scene at pens when true "Hurdle pens, mucky, full of somebody else's sheep.".
  Observe mound_scene at mound when true "From the top of the mound you can see the road for miles, and anyone on it.".
  Observe pit_scene at pit when true "A pit under the hall, roofed with timber, full of plunder. In the far wall a low stone-lined passage goes off into the dark, and a draught comes down it that smells of gorse.".
  Observe gorse_scene at gorse when true "A hole among the gorse below the ring, half hidden, worn smooth at the lip.".

  Thing chest "a chest under the fleeces" at den {
    Holds.
    State locked closed "The chest under the fleeces is locked, with a padlock as big as a fist.".
    State open "The chest under the fleeces stands open.".
    Change pick "Pick the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
    Change smash "Smash the chest's padlock" from locked to open needing brawn.
  }
  Thing heap "a heap of plunder" at pit {
    Holds.
  }
  Discovery backway_known "A passage leaves the ring-fort's store-pit and comes out in a hole among the gorse below the ring." {
    Found by searching pit "The draught comes from a souterrain, a stone-lined crawl going off under the bank.".
    Found by searching outside with woodcraft "Among the gorse below the ring, a hole worn smooth at the lip, and the smell of smoke coming out of it.".
  }
  Goal false.
}
data/rules/care.kyr:
Module care "Rest, mending and lessons" {
  Kind member. Kind ability. Kind reward. Kind circle.
  Entity circle_1: circle "first-level slot". Entity circle_2: circle "second-level slot".
  Entity circle_3: circle "third-level slot". Entity circle_4: circle "fourth-level slot".
  Entity circle_5: circle "fifth-level slot". Entity circle_6: circle "sixth-level slot".
  Entity circle_7: circle "seventh-level slot". Entity circle_8: circle "eighth-level slot".
  Entity circle_9: circle "ninth-level slot".
  Relation swappable(member, circle, ability, ability).
  Kind quality.
  Entity strength: quality "Strength". Entity dexterity: quality "Dexterity". Entity constitution: quality "Constitution".
  Entity intelligence: quality "Intelligence". Entity wisdom: quality "Wisdom". Entity charisma: quality "Charisma".
  Relation improvable(member). Relation learnable(member, ability).
  Kind feat. Relation featOpen(member, feat).
  Relation memberOf(member, group).
  Relation fieldUsable(ability).
  Relation awake(member). Relation needsCare(member). Relation canCast(member, ability). Relation treatable(member, ability).
  Relation restful(place). Relation offeredAt(reward, place). Relation giftEffect(reward, ability).
  Relation rewardFor(reward, fact). Relation claimed(reward).
  Goal false.
  Action field_spell(actor: group, caster: member, technique: ability, recipient: member, site: place) "Have {caster} use {technique} on {recipient}" {
    Description "A healing, a cleansing or a ward, used between fights, for its usual cost in mana.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and memberOf(caster, actor) and memberOf(recipient, actor)
      and fieldUsable(technique) and awake(caster) and awake(recipient) and canCast(caster, technique) and treatable(recipient, technique).
    Resolve invoke(technique, caster, recipient).
    Result "{caster} uses {technique} on {recipient}.".
  }
  Action prepare_spell(actor: group, caster: member, tier: circle, outgoing: ability, incoming: ability) "Have {caster} prepare {incoming} in place of {outgoing}, in a {tier}" {
    Description "An hour of study or prayer. A spell prepared in a slot still ready can be cast at once; in a slot already spent, after the next rest.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(caster, actor) and awake(caster) and swappable(caster, tier, outgoing, incoming).
    Time 6.
    Resolve prepare(caster, tier, outgoing, incoming).
    Result "{caster} spends an hour over {incoming}.".
  }
  Action raise_quality(actor: group, member: member, quality: quality) "Have {member} raise {quality}" {
    Description "Each level gained lets a companion raise one quality by a point. Strength lands blows and Dexterity turns them; Constitution adds hit points at the next level; Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma feeds a caster's spells.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(member, actor) and awake(member) and improvable(member).
    Resolve improve(member, quality).
    Result "{member} grows in {quality}.".
  }
  Action learn_spell(actor: group, member: member, spell: ability) "Have {member} learn {spell}" {
    Description "Each level gained lets a caster add a spell of their tradition, of a level they can cast, to what they know. It can be prepared from then on.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(member, actor) and awake(member) and learnable(member, spell).
    Resolve learn(member, spell).
    Result "{member} learns {spell}.".
  }
  Action take_feat(actor: group, member: member, choice: feat) "Have {member} take up {choice}" {
    Description "At the fifth, tenth and fifteenth levels a companion takes up one of their calling's feats. Some rule others out: a knight is no barbarian.".
    Requires able(actor) and memberOf(member, actor) and awake(member) and featOpen(member, choice).
    Resolve feat(member, choice).
    Result "{member} takes up {choice}.".
  }
  Action rest(actor: group, site: place) "Rest and recover at {site}" {
    Description "Six hours and a ration, somewhere safe. The living get their strength and mana back, and bleeding is stopped; poison and death are not mended. The world does not wait while you sleep.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and restful(site) and quantity(actor, rations) >= 1.
    Time 36. Resolve recover(actor). Interrupted when threatened(actor).
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, rations) by 1. }
    Result "You eat, bind your hurts and sleep for six hours.".
  }
  Action learn_reward(actor: group, gift: reward, recipient: member, lesson: ability, proof: fact, site: place) "Accept {gift} for {recipient}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and offeredAt(gift, site) and memberOf(recipient, actor)
      and awake(recipient) and giftEffect(gift, lesson) and rewardFor(gift, proof) and knows(actor, proof)
      and not claimed(gift).
    Resolve reward(lesson, recipient).
    On success { Assert claimed(gift). Retract offeredAt(gift, site). Retract at(gift, site). }
    Result "{recipient} studies {gift} until {lesson} comes easily.".
  }
}

data/rules/passages.kyr:
Module world_passages "Passages, obstacles and the condition of things" {
  Kind passage. Kind condition. Kind change. Kind thing. Kind waykind. Kind hazard.
  // What is seen and changes but is not handled: the weather, a river, a beacon on a far hill.
  Kind scenery.
  Relation passageKind(passage, waykind). Measure travelTime(passage).
  Relation connects(passage, place, place).
  Relation on(entity, passage).
  Relation guards(group, passage).
  Relation state(entity, condition) exclusive.
  Relation blocksWhen(entity, condition). Relation harmsWhen(entity, condition).
  Relation hurtsWith(entity, hazard). Relation hurtsInto(entity, condition).
  Relation revealedBy(entity, fact).
  // Containment: a thing or item inside another, reachable while that one is not shut; a receptacle can take more.
  Relation inside(entity, entity). Relation receptacle(entity). Relation closesWhen(entity, condition).
  // A hazard that strikes a company: the world turns it on one of its members (a trap sprung, a stone that falls).
  Relation strikes(hazard, group).
  // What can be tried on a thing (looked over closely, prodded, pried at...), and what has been.
  Kind verb. Relation probeable(entity). Relation tried(entity, verb).
  Relation needs(entity, entity).
  Relation changeOf(change, entity). Relation changeFrom(change, condition). Relation changeTo(change, condition).
  // A change only one side reaches (the bar on the cellar side of a door) is made from that place.
  Relation changeAt(change, place).
  Query placedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeAt(c, ?p) or (changeAt(c, ?p) and at(a, ?p)).
  Relation changeKnows(change, fact). Relation consumes(change, good). Relation spends(change, itemkind).
  Relation hobbled(group).
  Relation following(group, group).
  Query holding(a: group, k: itemkind) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(?i, ?m) and itemKind(?i, k).
  // Carrying a particular thing: this key, not any key.
  Query carries(a: group, i: entity) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(i, ?m).
  // What a way or a change needs: a skill, a kind of thing, or one particular thing.
  Query meets(a: group, n: entity) means capable(a, n) or holding(a, n) or carries(a, n)
    or (following(a, ?l) and holding(?l, n)).
  Query equippedFor(a: group, x: entity) means not needs(x, ?n) or (needs(x, ?n) and meets(a, ?n)).
  Query informedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeKnows(c, ?f) or (changeKnows(c, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)).
  Query visibleTo(w: passage, a: group) means not revealedBy(w, ?f) or (revealedBy(w, ?f) and knows(a, ?f))
    or (revealedBy(w, ?g) and following(a, ?l) and knows(?l, ?g)).
  Query barred(w: passage) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s).
  // Who holds the key to what bars a way, and those who serve them, go through it as if it were open.
  Relation keyholder(group, entity).
  Query opens(a: group, o: entity) means keyholder(a, o) or (serves(a, ?m) and keyholder(?m, o)).
  Query barredFor(w: passage, a: group) means on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s) and not opens(a, ?o).
  Query watched(w: passage) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q).
  Query obstructed(w: passage) means barred(w) or watched(w).
  Query watchedAgainst(w: passage, a: group) means guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)
    and at(?g, ?p) and connects(w, ?p, ?q) and not allied(?g, a) and not tolerates(?g, a).
  Query hazardous(w: passage) means on(?h, w) and state(?h, ?s) and harmsWhen(?h, ?s).
  Query mobile(a: group) means not hobbled(a) or following(a, ?l).
  Query together(a: group, b: group) means at(a, ?p) and at(b, ?p).
  Query shut(c: entity) means state(c, ?s) and closesWhen(c, ?s).
  // A thing hidden until something is known is not there, for a company that does not know it; nor is a thing on a way
  // the company does not know of.
  Query onHiddenWay(x: entity, a: group) means on(x, ?w) and not visibleTo(?w, a).
  Query noticed(x: entity, a: group) means (not revealedBy(x, ?f) or (revealedBy(x, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)))
    and not onHiddenWay(x, a).
  Query reaches(a: group, t: entity) means noticed(t, a) and ((at(a, ?p) and at(t, ?p))
    or (at(a, ?q) and on(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?q) and guards(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r) and at(t, ?r))
    or (at(a, ?h) and inside(t, ?c) and at(?c, ?h) and not shut(?c))).
  Query passable(w: passage, a: group) means visibleTo(w, a) and not barredFor(w, a) and not watchedAgainst(w, a)
    and not hazardous(w)
    and equippedFor(a, w).
  Goal false.

  Action go(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place) "Take {way} to {destination}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and passable(way, actor)
      and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Seen "{actor} takes {way} toward {destination}.".
  }
  Action slip_past(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, gatekeeper: group) "Slip past {gatekeeper} by {way}" {
    Description "Someone who moves quietly takes the company past a watcher without a fight or a bargain. The watcher stays where it is, and will be there on the way back.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and guards(gatekeeper, way)
      and able(gatekeeper) and state(gatekeeper, ?t) and blocksWhen(gatekeeper, ?t) and not tolerates(gatekeeper, actor)
      and (at(gatekeeper, origin) or at(gatekeeper, destination))
      and capable(actor, stealth)
      and visibleTo(way, actor) and not barred(way) and not hazardous(way) and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Result "One at a time, keeping low and downwind, you slip past {gatekeeper}.".
  }
  Action risk(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, trap: entity, blow: hazard, after: condition, victim: member) "Risk {trap}; {victim} goes first" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and on(trap, way)
      and state(trap, ?s) and harmsWhen(trap, ?s) and hurtsWith(trap, blow) and hurtsInto(trap, after)
      and memberOf(victim, actor) and awake(victim) and visibleTo(way, actor) and not obstructed(way)
      and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Resolve expose(blow, victim).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert state(trap, after). Assert at(actor, destination). }
    On failure { Assert state(trap, after). }
  }
  Action change_thing(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and not consumes(how, ?g) and not spends(how, ?k).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_spending(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: item, form: itemkind, carrier: member) "{how}, using {carrier}'s {spent}" {
    Description "What it takes is used up doing it.".
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and spends(how, form) and memberOf(carrier, actor) and awake(carrier)
      and ownedItem(spent, carrier) and itemKind(spent, form).
    Resolve drop(spent, carrier).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_paying(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: good) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and placedFor(actor, how) and not dead(thing) and not benighted(actor) and consumes(how, spent) and quantity(actor, spent) >= 1.
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). Decrease quantity(actor, spent) by 1. }
  }
}

data/sites/silkholme/site.kyr:
Module silkholme "Silkholme sink" {
  Description "A chalk sinkhole on the ridge above Reedwake. Its lip is quiet grass; below, the chalk opens into caves that something has hung with silk.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Place march "The region" is region.
  Place ridge "The high approach" is room.

  Place silkholme "Silkholme sink" is site within march at 2, 1.
  Place lip "the lip of the sink" is room within silkholme at 0, 0.
  Place frames "the frame terrace" is room within silkholme at 1, 0.
  Place caves "The caves below" is level within silkholme.
  Place cave "the lower cave" is room within caves at 0, 1.
  Place nest "the nest" is room within caves at 1, 1.
  Initially Assert unlit(cave). Initially Assert unlit(nest).

  Passage sink_path "the sink path" is path between ridge and lip taking 30 minutes.
  Passage terrace_steps "the terrace steps" is path between lip and frames.
  Passage shaft "the sink shaft" is climb between lip and cave needing rope or climbing.
  Passage seep "the seep crawl" is crawl between frames and cave taking 1 hour.
  Passage web_gallery "the web gallery" is passage between cave and nest.

  Observe sink_lip at lip when true "The grass runs right to the edge and stops. Below, the chalk drops into a round shaft, white at the top and grey further down, and cool air comes up out of it.".
  Observe frame_terrace at frames when true "A ledge cut into the side of the sink, sheltered from the wind. A wet fissure at the back of the ledge breathes cave air.".
  Observe lower_cave at cave when true "Water drips from the chalk into shallow pools. Pale threads run along the walls towards a low arch, and every thread trembles a little.".
  Observe nest_room at nest when true "A high chamber, its roof lost in grey silk. Old husks of sheep and rabbits hang in the threads like washing.".
  Goal false.
}
